summary: United Community Banks, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its wholly owned bank subsidiary's agreement to sell all equity of Navitas Credit Corp. (equipment lease financing) and NLFC Reinsurance Corp. to Navitas TopCo LLC. The cash consideration is a formula: Base Purchase Price (outstanding principal of owned equipment financings up to $2.15B plus 7.346% premium on the first ~$1.756B, plus 4% on excess up to cap), plus Incremental Asset Premium, Closing Cash, and adjustments for Non-Portfolio Net Assets/Liabilities minus Closing Indebtedness and Transaction Expenses. United guarantees the Bank's obligations. The board likely approved; no advisor named. The closing is subject to conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and the final portfolio balance to calculate exact proceeds.
